newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease to end at 21.375 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease to end at 21.375 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates eased on Monday to end at 21.375 percent compared with Friday's 21.50 percent close, traders said.
"This is a good sign on the first day (of the banks' two-week reserve period)," said Gabor Kornis of ABN AMRO Bank, adding that he did not exclude a rise over the next few days.
"It could happen if excess funds are again soaked up into the (central bank's) reverse repo," he said.
